about: planTransfer on the receiver's stored values (`storage`) and a decoded code (`incoming`): the plan (additions, resets, keptLocal, settings, warnings, empty, writes; `before` is `storage` and is omitted) and the storage after its writes. Units are (date, period), (date, sura) and (date, phrase key); the later reset epoch takes a unit whole, equal epochs join (max, OR, earliest instant).

cases.name: join: today's counts take the per-item max, history days union (OR, earliest instant), suwar pages OR, tasbih max
the union completes a period: completedAt is the merge instant
the sender reset later: the receiver's stale counts are replaced (resets row with before/after)
the receiver reset later: the sender's stale counts are ignored (keptLocal row)
history days deleted on the sender (tombstones) are deleted here
history days deleted here stay deleted
a card reset makes the whole period the later side's (limitation: the other side's other cards go)
suwar: pages OR; a sura reset wins for that sura only
tasbih: a phrase reset wins for that phrase only; other phrases take the max
tasbih: phrases beyond the cap of 8 are dropped with their counts (warning), never folded into another key
